senses.sense_definition: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

examples.text: Try to see the problem from my <w>perspective</w> before you judge.

senses.sense_definition: The ability to understand the true importance of things relative to each other; a sensible view of the world.

examples.text: It is important to keep things in <w>perspective</w> and not worry about minor details.

target_lang_translations.it: È importante mantenere le cose nella giusta <w>prospettiva</w> e non preoccuparsi dei dettagli minori.

senses.sense_definition: The art or technique of drawing solid objects on a two-dimensional surface so as to give the right impression of their height, width, depth, and position in relation to each other.

target_lang_translations.zh: 画家运用<w>透视法</w>，让这条路看起来像是一直延伸到远方。

target_lang_definitions.de: Die Kunst oder Technik, dreidimensionale Objekte auf einer zweidimensionalen Fläche so darzustellen, dass ein korrekter Eindruck von Tiefe und räumlicher Position entsteht.
